industryPackIngestion.resolution: Reduce metadata size by shortening SID list or using group-level SIDs instead of individual user SIDs

findings.title: Citation file names show UUID-based S3 keys instead of human-readable names
findings.description: KB data source contains auto-generated JSON files with UUID filenames (e.g., reports/esg/2026-06-06/5578ceee-ac4d-4bb7-a431-d82afed79f04.json). The citation display shows these raw S3 keys which are not user-friendly.
findings.recommendation: Extract document title or use_case from JSON content to display as citation label. Fallback to filename if metadata unavailable.

findings.title: Smart Routing auto mode requires initial model selection
findings.description: When Smart Routing is ON but no model is selected in the UI, the system falls back to Nova 2 Lite instead of auto-selecting based on query complexity.
findings.recommendation: Auto-select default model (e.g., Sonnet 4.6) when Smart Routing is enabled and no model is explicitly chosen.

findings.title: Claude Sonnet 4 requires Inference Profile ID in ap-northeast-1
findings.description: UI model selector passes 'anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6' but Bedrock rejects on-demand invocation. Must use 'jp.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6' (inference profile). Fallback to Nova 2 Lite occurs, preventing Prompt Caching from working.
findings.recommendation: Add inference profile resolution in model-defaults.ts or converse-client.ts: map base model IDs to regional inference profile IDs.

findings.title: S3 Vectors 2048B filterable metadata limit causes ingestion failures
findings.description: 31 documents failed ingestion due to metadata exceeding 2048 bytes (long SID lists). Documents with 4+ long SIDs exceed the limit.
findings.recommendation: Limit allowed_group_sids to 3-5 entries or switch to OpenSearch Serverless (no size limit).
